ads.headline: I thought the reviews were just hype.
ads.brief: Review-card concept. The German LACALUT AKTIV toothpaste tube on a clean, bright, premium background. Set the headline like a customer review / speech-bubble card with a subtle 5-star cue. Warm, credible, editorial feel. Add a smaller supporting line: 'Then came the firm, fresh feel.' Cosmetic feel-and-fresh language only.
ads.prom: the astringent, tightening LACALUT feel on the gumline

ads.headline: Say goodbye to gum-care gimmicks
ads.brief: A real highway billboard with the German LACALUT AKTIV toothpaste tube shown LARGE on the right side of the billboard; the billboard itself carries the headline as its out-of-home message. Premium, bold, confident. Cars/road context so it reads as a genuine billboard.

ads.headline: Burns. → Tightens.
ads.brief: Clean split-screen comparison. LEFT: a plain UNBRANDED generic white toothpaste tube labelled 'Burns.' RIGHT: the German LACALUT AKTIV tube labelled 'Tightens.' Do NOT use any real competitor brand, logo or pack — the left tube is generic and unbranded. Simple, bold, high-contrast layout; the two labels are the hero text.
ads.prom: astringent tightening feel vs an ordinary stinging paste

ads.headline: My mouth feels so much happier when I wake up.
ads.brief: Two-panel before/after. LEFT (night): a dim bathroom, a hand on the light switch, the German LACALUT AKTIV tube on the counter, small label 'Last thing tonight.' RIGHT (morning): the SAME counter in soft morning sunlight, the tube in the same spot. The customer quote sits large in a review-card style, with a small 'LACALUT customer' line beneath it. Natural, cohesive lighting in each panel.
ads.prom: the firm, fresh, cared-for feeling that lasts to morning
